verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents export of individual designs to open formats (HTML, PDF, PPTX). Community reports add that a data export includes Design chats and code in a design_chats directory even without current access. However, users report losing in-product access to projects after unsubscribing, and the team only promised to fix this, so leaving cleanly with all data is not documented first-party. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all projects and chats, documented post-cancellation download path, independent confirmation of complete export coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, share an org-scoped link, hand off to Claude Code, or send to the apps you already use daily.
If you export your data, all your Claude Design chats are in a design_chats directory along with the code, even if your account currently has no access to Claude Design.
Claude's designs are HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle
